# A canvas's drawing context is cairo's over GDI+: a path built of lines,
# curves and arcs turning either way, closed or not, filled and kept for a
# stroke, stroked in each cap and join at a width, in colors with alpha;
# text from its baseline in a generic family, a named one and an unknown
# one, which draws in sans-serif; and a drawing painted in place through a
# translate, a scale and a clip, which save and restore undo. The snapshot
# holds the pixels, in C and in Go through the wrappers and called directly,
# and in C for 386.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c paint.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
exists paint.sngl.snapshots/paint.png

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go paint.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go --opt cgo=direct paint.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c --opt arch=386 paint.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

-- paint.sngl --
import draw "sngl:ui/draw"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component main ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        draw.canvas(width=320px, height=200px) {
            draw.rect(x=10.0, y=10.0, w=60.0, h=40.0, style=draw.Style{fill=color{r=255, g=0, b=0, a=128}, stroke=#0000ff, strokeWidth=3.0})
            draw.circle(cx=110.0, cy=30.0, r=20.0, style=draw.Style{stroke=#008000, strokeWidth=2.5})
            draw.ellipse(cx=170.0, cy=30.0, rx=30.0, ry=15.0, style=draw.Style{fill=#ffa500})
            draw.line(x1=210.0, y1=15.0, x2=300.0, y2=15.0, style=draw.Style{stroke=#000000, strokeWidth=8.0, lineCap=draw.LineCap.round})
            draw.line(x1=210.0, y1=35.0, x2=300.0, y2=35.0, style=draw.Style{stroke=#000000, strokeWidth=8.0, lineCap=draw.LineCap.square})
            draw.line(x1=210.0, y1=55.0, x2=300.0, y2=55.0, style=draw.Style{stroke=#000000, strokeWidth=8.0})
            draw.path(style=draw.Style{stroke=#800080, strokeWidth=6.0, lineJoin=draw.LineJoin.round}) {
                draw.moveTo(x=10.0, y=120.0)
                draw.lineTo(x=40.0, y=70.0)
                draw.lineTo(x=70.0, y=120.0)
            }
            draw.path(style=draw.Style{stroke=#800080, strokeWidth=6.0, lineJoin=draw.LineJoin.bevel}) {
                draw.moveTo(x=80.0, y=120.0)
                draw.lineTo(x=110.0, y=70.0)
                draw.lineTo(x=140.0, y=120.0)
            }
            draw.path(style=draw.Style{fill=#00ffff, stroke=#000000, strokeWidth=2.0}) {
                draw.moveTo(x=150.0, y=120.0)
                draw.lineTo(x=150.0, y=70.0)
                draw.arcTo(cx=200.0, cy=70.0, x=200.0, y=120.0, r=20.0)
                draw.arcTo(cx=200.0, cy=120.0, x=150.0, y=120.0, r=15.0)
                draw.close()
            }
            draw.path(style=draw.Style{stroke=#ff00ff, strokeWidth=2.0}) {
                draw.moveTo(x=210.0, y=120.0)
                draw.bezierTo(cx1=230.0, cy1=60.0, cx2=270.0, cy2=140.0, x=300.0, y=80.0)
                draw.arcTo(cx=310.0, cy=120.0, x=260.0, y=125.0, r=10.0)
            }
            draw.canvasText(x=10.0, y=150.0, content="Serif 18", style=draw.Style{fill=#000000, fontFamily="serif", fontSize=18.0})
            draw.canvasText(x=110.0, y=150.0, content="Mono 12", style=draw.Style{fill=#0000ff, fontFamily="monospace", fontSize=12.0})
            draw.canvasText(x=200.0, y=150.0, content="Named", style=draw.Style{fill=#008000, fontFamily="Tahoma"})
            draw.canvasText(x=10.0, y=190.0, content="Unknown family", style=draw.Style{fill=color{r=0, g=0, b=0, a=160}, fontFamily="NoSuchFamily"})
            draw.canvasImage(x=200.0, y=160.0, w=80.0, h=36.0) {
                draw.image(width=20.0, height=9.0) {
                    draw.rect(x=0.0, y=0.0, w=20.0, h=9.0, style=draw.Style{fill=#c0c0c0})
                    draw.circle(cx=20.0, cy=4.5, r=6.0, style=draw.Style{fill=#ff0000, stroke=#000000})
                }
            }
            draw.circle(cx=300.0, cy=180.0, r=12.0, style=draw.Style{fill=#0000ff})
        }
    }
}

ui.window(title="Paint") {
    main()
}

func testPaints(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("paint")
}
